title: open source?
body: Will this eventually be open source? or is it a closed-source product?
author: mindplay-dk

top_comments.author: 8enmann
top_comments.body: We currently don't have plans to open source it.

top_comments.author: 8enmann
top_comments.body: Open sourcing a project changes how a team works dramatically, and we're not at a stage where we think we can be good public stewards yet. Appreciate the interest!

top_comments.author: 8enmann
top_comments.body: @nick4fake Claude Code is an MCP client so you can extend it that way. Would that be sufficient?
